about: 批改考题集（flow/ai_eval.py）：换模型或改提示词之前，用这些固定的题看 AI 批改得对不对。rewrite：expect=fix 的句子有一个典型错误，改后不能再有 bad 里的片段（第一项是句子里的错误本身，后面是不能出现的错误改法），要有 good 里的任一种改法（以 ^ 开头的要出现在句首），fix 是一种参考改法；expect=keep 的句子本来就对，不能被改。essay：同一个写作任务的三篇短文，rank 1 最好，分数要按顺序拉开，同一篇评两次分数要稳。translate：材料原句的中文和学习者的两种英文译文，好的分要明显高于差的。

essay.text: For me, the most magical everyday technology is the automatic door at my local supermarket. As a child, I believed the door could somehow see me coming, and it still feels a little like magic when it slides open just before I reach it. In reality, the door is not watching me so much as measuring changes around it. A small sensor above the entrance sends out invisible signals and notices when something moving breaks the pattern. The door then opens and stays open until the area is clear again. Knowing how it works has not spoiled the effect. If anything, I now admire the simple idea behind it even more.

I think the most magic technology in my life is the mobile payment. When I go to shopping, I only need to show my phone and the money is paid. It is very convenient, I don't need to bring my wallet anymore. But actually the phone is not doing magic so much as send information to the bank. The shop scan a code, and the bank check my account and move the money in one second. Sometimes the network is bad and I can't pay, it make me very worried. I hope this technology can become more safe in the future.

I think phone is very magic. I very like my phone, every day I use it. It can do many thing, talk with friend, see video, buy thing. I don't know how it work, maybe it have small computer inside. Phone is not magic so much as computer. My father say young people use phone too much, I think he is right but I can't stop.
